hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *.sh ]] && command -v shellcheck &>/dev/null; then shellcheck --severity=warning "$FILE"; fi

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_OUTPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$FILE" == *scripts/hooks/*.sh || "$FILE" == *tests/hooks/*.sh ]]; then bash tests/hooks/run_all.sh 2>&1 || true; fi
